projects.title: DroneAid
projects.description: A 3D quadcopter flight simulation built in Simulink and Simscape Multibody. Final-year project. Implements a full closed-loop cascade control system — inner angular-rate loops, outer attitude loops and altitude hold — flying an autonomous waypoint search-and-locate mission. Gains were derived analytically from measured mass and inertia rather than tuned by hand.
projects.summary: 3D quadcopter flight simulation with a full cascade control stack, flying an autonomous waypoint search-and-locate mission.
